title: Bites of Dallas: BBQ, Tex-Mex & Pie Walk
blurb: Discover the bold flavors and rich culture of Texas cuisine on a guided walking tour through Deep Ellum—one of Dallas’s most vibrant and historic neighborhoods. From smoky brisket and spicy Tex-Mex to savory sweet homemade pie, you’ll sample the best bites this city has to offer. Along the way, take in colorful murals, hear stories of blues legends, and soak up the creative energy that makes Deep Ellum a true Texas original. Come hungry—this tour brings the heat, the flavor, and all the fixin’s.
